_comment: Runtime config for the AIxodia daemon/bridge. Copy to config/aixodia.json (gitignored) and edit. This file holds NO credential: the app/engine use one Cloudflare API token; the Named Tunnel connector token is stored separately in Cloudflare Workers KV and never sent to the app.
_d1: There is no Worker any more (D-011). Nothing D1-related belongs in this file: the app resolves the account and the database from the token itself, and the schema is applied with wrangler straight to the Cloudflare API (see db/README.md).
_workers_kv: Create namespace AIXODIA_CONFIG with tunnel_token and tunnel_url. The engine writes daemon/url and daemon/version only when changed. No heartbeat key is used.
